title: Hunts FH-020Y: Let a resident Trail name a partner venue for a staff-confirmed stop
detail:
FH-020X binds every stop and takes the venue Space from the Space that runs the Trail. A resident creates Trails as a profile owner (createTrailDraft), so the publish checklist refuses a staff-confirmed stop there (stop_staff_venue): no venue means no staff can confirm a visit or review a held one (lib/hunts/staff-queue-store.ts drops a claim with no venue). Add a per-stop venue choice limited to Spaces with an active hunt_partners row for the Hunt (authz partnerAllows), write it as the binding's venue_space_id in bindStopPlacements, and let the checklist pass when each staff-confirmed stop has one. Needs the partner invite flow or an owner decision on who may name a venue. Requires: FH-020X. Owner role: Web.

Built 2026-11-16 on FH-030S's Partner places. The per-stop venue field is now venueSpaceId (lib/studio/entities/hunt.ts, lib/hunts/draft.ts StopVenue), and lib/hunts/store.ts bindStopPlacements writes it as the binding's venue_space_id, else the Space that runs the Trail. On a resident's Trail (no own Space) the venue options are only partners live now (partnerLive). The publish checklist's stop_staff_venue now passes when every place a staff-confirmed stop's codes sit at (venue and substitute) has staff who may confirm there: the running Space's own, or a partner that is live and holds the operator role authz partnerAllows asks for (partners.ts partnerConfirms, loaded fresh in loadVenueFacts as staffVenues). A stop with no named venue on a resident's Trail, at a withdrawn partner, or at a partner without the operator role is still refused. The held-visit binding then names the partner, so lib/hunts/staff-queue-store.ts attributes the claim and decide('review_claim') lets that partner's staff review it (stop-placements.test.ts). Who may name a venue: the Hunt's own editors (owner, admin, editor via edit_draft, publish via publish), and only a live partner can be named; no owner decision is needed because the partner already accepted the terms through the FH-029 invite. No migration. Hunts switches stay off.
